title: Fullstack Developer with Backend Focus
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

We are looking for a fullstack engineer with a strong backend center of gravity who enjoys designing reliable systems, thinking rigorously about correctness, and applying strong software fundamentals to real-world operational problems.

Platform touches both client facing features as well as internal tooling. The capabilities we own are the ones our users touch most often: how workflows and dashboards are configured, how fast a screen full of exceptions loads, how consistently permissions behave, how reliably a release reaches production. When the platform is right, every product team ships better software faster, and that lands directly with the tens of thousands of people who use blp every day. Platform decisions here are judged by what they do for our users, not by internal elegance.

What you'll do

- Build the Foundation: Design and develop the shared backend services and APIs that our product teams depend on, with clear contracts and abstractions that fit how they actually work.

- Drive User Impact: Work with product teams and business stakeholders to understand where the platform is holding them back, communicate trade-offs openly, and turn that into concrete improvements our users feel.

- Own Reliability and Correctness: Build and operate systems with a strong focus on robustness, and improve them continuously through careful analysis and iteration. Managing entropy in a complex system is part of the job, and we expect you to adapt accordingly.

- Build Great Software: Write clean, maintainable, high-quality code across the stack. Conduct code reviews and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.

- Shape Architecture: Collaborate on system design, tech stack decisions, and platform boundaries, optimizing for scalability, performance, and maintainability.

- Lead and Influence: Guide technical direction on major initiatives such as migrations and platform capabilities, and mentor team members along the way.

- Promote Innovation and Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues to continuously improve processes, tools, and team practices, fostering a culture of learning and growth.

The tech stack includes Golang, React/TypeScript, Python, various ML models, MySQL, F#, Docker images deployed on a Kubernetes cluster in our cloud infrastructure (GCS, AWS, or Azure), and GitHub CI/CD.

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a clear backend focus.

- Genuine fullstack capability: comfortable working in a modern React/TypeScript codebase, even if backend is where you do your deepest work.

- Experience with functional programming concepts or languages.

- Passionate about software craftsmanship: strong understanding of core engineering principles including type systems, composition, testing, Clean Code, and Clean Architecture.

- Product thinking: ability to translate business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately into code.

- Entrepreneurial mindset: link your daily work to team and company goals, balance cost and benefit, deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.

- Ownership: take responsibility for your technical work, for the platform we build, and for the team we shape.

- Abstraction and efficient communication: simplify complex systems, identify core concepts, and communicate complex ideas clearly.

Nice to have

- Familiarity with distributed systems, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with ERP systems, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes.

- Background in a platform, infrastructure, or developer experience team.

- Experience with large-scale migrations or incremental modernization of an existing codebase.

- German language skills.

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building a platform that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable. Because our work sits underneath every product team, we also value people who can hold both perspectives at once: the rigor to get the foundation right, and the product sense to know which foundation is worth building.

What you'll get

- Ownership of the platform layer. Every product team builds on it, and you have real influence over how it's defined.

- Work that reaches real scale. It lands directly with the tens of thousands of people who use blp every day, not just internal elegance.

- A high-caliber engineering culture. Collaborative, and one that values correctness and craftsmanship.

- Structured onboarding. Continuous learning follows as the platform's scope grows.

This role is available on-site in Zurich, London, Barcelona or remotely within Europe.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Software Engineer, Internal Audit (All Levels)

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

About the Role

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. What You'll Do

- 
Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop

- 
Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack

- 
Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time

Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas

Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices

Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage

Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health

- 
Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs

- 
Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture)

- 
Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

At the Staff level, you may:

- 
Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture

- 
Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

- 
Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy

- 
Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design

Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions

Experience

Must-have: 

- 
Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users

- 
Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration

- 
Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec

- 
A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts

Nice-to-have:

A track record of 0→1 projects you took from nothing to something people use

Experience in internal audit, SOX, financial services, accounting, or compliance

Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Temporal

Experience with document processing, PDF/Excel manipulation, or evaluation frameworks for model output

Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

Flexible time off and work schedules

Technology reimbursements

401(k) plan

title: Chief Architect
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

Chief Architect 

Remote - US 

Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation.

This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems.

This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity. 

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties 

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making 

Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution.

- Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization.

- Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction.

- Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability.

- Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk.

- Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

Platform Architecture and Technical Vision 

- Define and own the long-term architecture for Legion’s AI-driven Workforce Management platform across application services, data infrastructure, ML systems, optimization engines, APIs, integration architecture, developer platforms, and enterprise-scale operations.

- Establish engineering-wide standards for system design, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, observability, security, and maintainability.

- Serve as the final architectural authority for major platform initiatives and technical decisions with long-term consequences.

- Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, improve system efficiency, accelerate engineering velocity, and unlock new product capabilities.

- Proactively surface technical debt, architectural risk, and platform constraints before they compound into customer, product, or engineering velocity issues.

- Create pragmatic migration paths from current-state architecture to target-state architecture while maintaining uptime, customer trust, backward compatibility, and delivery speed.

- Ensure Legion’s AI capabilities remain differentiated, defensible, enterprise-ready, and deeply integrated into operational workflows rather than bolted on as superficial features.

Distributed Systems, Data, and Enterprise Scale 

- Drive architecture for large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS systems serving complex enterprise customers with high availability, performance, security, and compliance expectations.

- Lead technical decisions involving microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed data processing, real-time systems, data governance, and large-scale analytics.

- Improve the architecture for observability, incident analysis, performance engineering, capacity planning, reliability, and operational excellence.

- Use production data, incidents, escalations, and customer operational patterns as inputs into architecture and platform improvement.

- Ensure architectural decisions support global scale, data residency, enterprise integrations, configurability, extensibility, and long-term platform leverage.

- Help evaluate technical implications of major product, partner, platform, and commercial decisions.

The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.

On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. - Not running the Parloa platform itself. That is a separate engineering role. The platform is your foundation, and you build what a specific customer needs on top of it.

- Not agent configuration. Business users design and configure agents in AMP. You build the integrations and capabilities those agents need.

- Not a people-management role. You are an individual contributor and write and review code every week.

title: Fullstack Developer: Frontend, UX, Mobile - Legal AI (m/w/d)
description:
Silvernova ist in 15 Monaten von 0 auf 400+ Anwaltskanzleien gewachsen. Unsere Investoren sind hochkarätige VCs und Partner von renommierten Anwaltskanzleien wie YPOG, CMS und Neon.

Wir bieten einen KI-Associate an, der in der Akte des Anwalts denkt. Optimiert für komplexe Aktenarbeit in der Sachverhaltserfassung, rechtlichen Bewertung und Schriftsatzerstellung. Damit sparen Anwälte täglich bis zu 4 Stunden Arbeitszeit.

Hinter unserem Associate stehen ein eigenes Preprocessing, juristische Wissensmodelle und ein hochspezialisiertes Agenten-Ökosystem, an dem unser Team für RAG, Backend, AI Ops und Cloud arbeitet. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der diese Technologie noch besser dorthin bringt, wo sie zählt: in die Hände der Anwältinnen und Anwälte.

Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership und willst mitgestalten? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen!

Aufgaben

Als Fullstack Developer mit Fokus auf Frontend und UX verantwortest du alles, was unsere Nutzer sehen, anfassen und lieben sollen. Du designst und implementierst Features Ende-zu-Ende: von der ersten Skizze über den Prototyp bis zum Release. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CTO, dem Produktteam und direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen.

Hier ein genauerer Überblick:

- Design & Mockups: Du entwirfst Oberflächen, Flows und Interaktionen, z. B. in Figma, und machst komplexe KI-Funktionen für Juristen intuitiv bedienbar.

- Prototyping: Du baust schnell klickbare Prototypen, testest sie mit echten Nutzern und entscheidest datenbasiert, was in Produktion geht.

- Frontend-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst unser Angular-Frontend (zard/ui) weiter und sorgst für eine schnelle, stabile und konsistente Anwendung.

- Mobile & Web: Du bringst Silvernova auf neue Geräte, ob iOS, Android oder als Web App.

- AI Tools: Du entwickelst die Werkzeuge und kleinen Helfer rund um unseren KI-Associate, die den Arbeitsalltag in der Kanzlei spürbar leichter machen, inklusive der dafür nötigen Backend-Anbindung (Python/Flask).

- End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Features vom Kundenwunsch bis zum Monitoring nach dem Release und entwickelst die Funktionen, über die Nutzer mit ihren Kollegen sprechen.

Was du nicht übernehmen musst: KI-Pipeline, Architektur, Datenbanken und Cloud-Infrastruktur verantworten bei uns Kollegen. Du kannst dich voll auf das Nutzererlebnis konzentrieren.

Qualifikation

Du vereinst ein Auge für gutes Design mit sauberem Engineering. Du kannst eine Idee nicht nur gestalten, sondern auch selbst bauen und ausliefern. Dir macht es Spaß, dich tief in die Perspektive deiner Nutzer hineinzuversetzen und in einem High-Growth-Startup schnell Ergebnisse zu liefern.

- Frontend-Exzellenz: Fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript und Angular, inklusive Performance-Optimierung. Erfahrung mit React oder Vue ist ebenfalls willkommen.

- Design-Kompetenz: Du hast ein Gespür für Design, Usability und Details und arbeitest sicher mit Figma oder vergleichbaren Tools.

- Fullstack-Verständnis: Du kannst dich in Python/Flask bewegen und Backend-Schnittstellen für deine Features selbst anbinden oder erweitern.

- Mobile Development: Idealerweise hast du bereits Apps für iOS, Android oder als PWA entwickelt.

- Engineering-Praxis: Du arbeitest mit GitHub und CI/CD, schreibst Tests und nutzt Monitoring (z. B. Sentry, Matomo, CloudWatch), um zu verstehen, wie deine Features tatsächlich genutzt werden.

- Berufserfahrung: Du hast bereits SaaS-Anwendungen entwickelt und Erfahrung darin, Kundenanforderungen direkt aufzunehmen und umzusetzen. Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung von KI-Tools ist ein Plus.

- Agiles Arbeiten: Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Scrum.

- Ownership ist ein zentraler Baustein in deiner Arbeit bei Silvernova. Du kannst anhand von Arbeitserfahrung zeigen, wie du selbständig und eigenverantwortlich Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt hast.

- Lernbereitschaft: Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen, Tools und Frameworks ein.

- Sprachen: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder Muttersprache sowie Englisch auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Wenn du nicht alles erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen Potenzial, nicht Perfektion.

Benefits

- Attraktive Vergütung: Mit Mitarbeiteranteilen profitierst du direkt vom Wachstum von Silvernova.

- Ownership und Freiheit: Als High-Growth-Startup kannst du bei uns deine Ideen einbringen, Neues ausprobieren und echten Impact schaffen. Je unkonventioneller, desto besser!

- Direkter Draht zum Nutzer: Deine Features landen innerhalb kürzester Zeit bei hunderten Kanzleien, und du bekommst das Feedback direkt mit.

- Wachse über dich hinaus: Wir geben dir Raum für unternehmerisches Arbeiten, damit du dich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

- Teamkultur: Dich erwartet ein dynamisches Team mit einem freundschaftlichen Miteinander und regelmäßigen Team-Events.

- Office-First: Weil wir an echten Austausch und ein Wir-Gefühl glauben, verbringen wir mindestens 3 Tage die Woche gemeinsam in unserem Münchner Büro.

- Ausstattung: Du bekommst einen leistungsstarken Laptop und alles, was du für produktives Arbeiten brauchst.

- Wellpass inklusive: Du erhältst Zugang zu hunderten Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten.

- Sparring mit dem CTO: Individuelles Sparring und regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions mit unserem CTO Nils.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder Alter. ♥️

title: Head of Development AI Agent Platform (m/w/d)
description:
Strategy & Transformation Consulting (s&t) ist eine unabhängige Strategie- und Transformationsberatung und unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, die Opportunitäten der digitalen Transformation im Hinblick auf Effizienzsteigerungen, die Erweiterung bestehender Geschäftsfelder sowie die Erschließung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten erfolgreich zu nutzen. Wir gestalten und implementieren Transformationen End-to-End durch die Verbindung von strategischer Beratung, tiefem Technologieverständnis und langjähriger Business-Erfahrung.

Mit dem rasanten Fortschritt im Bereich Artificial Intelligence unterstützen wir Unternehmen bei der Identifikation, Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter KI-Anwendungsfälle. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung intelligenter AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, AI Assistants und KI-gestützter Automatisierungslösungen, die messbare geschäftliche Mehrwerte schaffen.

Aktuell entwickeln wir ein eigenes KI-Produkt: eine Plattform, auf der KI-Agenten für Unternehmensprozesse entworfen, orchestriert, betrieben und gesteuert werden. Das Produkt entsteht vollständig in der Microsoft-Cloud (Azure) und wird in C#/.NET umgesetzt. Für die technische Leitung dieses Produkts suchen wir ab sofort Sie als Entwicklungsleiter / Head of Development – AI Agent Platform (m/w/d) – Home Office / remote.

Aufgaben

Sie verantworten die technische Entwicklung des Produkts End-to-End – von der Architektur über die Umsetzung mit einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Team bis zum stabilen produktiven Betrieb in der Cloud. Sie arbeiten direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Produktmanagement zusammen und haben große Gestaltungsfreiheit.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- Technische Leitung und Architekturverantwortung für die AI Agent Platform auf Basis von Microsoft Azure und C#/.NET

- Entwurf, Programmierung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-Agenten, Multi-Agent-Systemen und Agentic Workflows inklusive Skills, Tools und Function/Tool Calling

- Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Wissensgraphen, RAG-Komponenten, Vektordatenbanken und Wissenssystemen als Grundlage der Agenten

- Integration von Foundation Models und Agent Frameworks im Microsoft-Ökosystem (z. B. Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework) sowie von MCP-Servern (Model Context Protocol) zur Anbindung interner und externer Systeme

- Aufbau und Betrieb des kompletten CI/CD-Zyklus: Azure DevOps bzw. GitHub, Infrastructure as Code, automatisierte Tests, Release-Management, Monitoring und Observability

- Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen aus Produktmanagement und Kundenprojekten in lauffähige, qualitativ hochwertige Produktinkremente

- Sicherstellung von Sicherheit, Mandantenfähigkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Kostenkontrolle und Betriebsstabilität der Cloud-Plattform

- Technische Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung eines kleinen Entwicklerteams sowie Steuerung externer Entwicklungspartner

- Etablierung von Entwicklungsstandards, Code Reviews, Dokumentation und einer modernen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungspraxis

- Aktive Mitgestaltung der Produkt-Roadmap gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung, Produktmanagement und Beratungsteam

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, davon mehrere Jahre in der Entwicklung KI-basierter Systeme, sowie über erste Erfahrung in der technischen Führung von Entwicklungsteams.

Zwingend erforderlich:

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten bzw. agentischen Systemen, die heute produktiv im Einsatz sind – bitte beschreiben Sie in Ihrer Bewerbung konkret, welche Agenten Sie gebaut haben und wo sie laufen

- Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in C# und .NET sowie ein solides Fundament in den Grundlagen der Softwareentwicklung (Datenstrukturen, Algorithmen, Architektur- und Entwurfsmuster, asynchrone Programmierung, Testbarkeit)

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft-Umgebung: Azure (App Services, Functions, Container Apps/AKS, Storage, Cosmos DB/SQL, Key Vault, Entra ID), Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel oder vergleichbare Frameworks

- Tiefes Verständnis, wie KI-Agenten konzipiert, programmiert, orchestriert, abgesichert und evaluiert werden (Planung, Tool Use, Memory, Guardrails, Evaluation, Kostensteuerung)

- Erfahrung mit dem kompletten CI/CD-Zyklus eines Cloud-Produkts: Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/Terraform), automatisierte Tests, Deployments, Monitoring

- Erfahrung in der Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in Produktfunktionen im Rahmen einer Produktentwicklung (nicht nur Projekt- oder Prototypenarbeit)

- Breites Wissen über Graphen und Wissensgraphen, Agenten-Architekturen, Skills/Tools, RAG, Vektordatenbanken und die Anwendung dieser Bausteine auf unterschiedliche fachliche Themen

Wünschenswert:

- Erfahrung mit MCP-Servern (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling und Agent-Orchestrierung über mehrere Systeme hinweg

- Kenntnisse in Python für Prototyping und Datenpipelines

- Erfahrung mit Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und Microservice-Architekturen

- Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungsumgebungen wie GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor oder vergleichbaren Lösungen

- Erfahrung in der Integration von Unternehmenssystemen (ERP, CRM, PLM, Dokumentenmanagement, Collaboration-Plattformen)

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Hands-on-Mentalität und der Anspruch, ein Produkt technisch von Anfang an richtig aufzubauen

- Strukturierte, qualitätsorientierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise

- Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte verständlich gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Produktmanagement und Kunden zu vermitteln

- Begeisterung für Artificial Intelligence und hohe Lernbereitschaft

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Sie bauen ein KI-Produkt von Grund auf mit und prägen dessen Architektur, Technologie und Entwicklungskultur. Sie arbeiten direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und erfahrenen Partnern zusammen, entscheiden technisch eigenverantwortlich und sehen die Ergebnisse Ihrer Arbeit unmittelbar bei unseren Kunden im Einsatz. Wir legen großen Wert auf Teamwork, flache Hierarchien und unternehmerische Freiräume, verzichten bewusst auf eine Up-or-Out-Philosophie und fördern langfristige Karrieren. Mit dem Wachstum des Produkts wächst auch Ihre Verantwortung – bis hin zur Gesamtverantwortung für Engineering und Betrieb der Plattform.

Wir bieten:

- Technische Gesamtverantwortung für ein neues KI-Produkt ab Tag 1

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Partnern und Entscheidungsträgern

- Moderne Toolchain und Zugang zu modernsten AI-Technologien im Microsoft-Ökosystem

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice

- Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

- Attraktive Vergütung sowie leistungsorientierte Entwicklungsperspektiven

- Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

- Ein hochmotiviertes Team mit ausgeprägtem Unternehmergeist

Ready to build the next generation of AI agents? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen – inklusive einer kurzen Beschreibung der von Ihnen entwickelten, produktiv eingesetzten KI-Agenten.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About us 

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Machine Learning and AI Team 👋 

Machine learning sits at the heart of Trainline's mission to help millions of people make sustainable travel choices every day. Our models power some of the most important parts of the platform, from search and recommendations across mobile and web, to pricing and routing optimisation, personalised experiences enhanced by generative AI, data-driven marketing, and AI agents that support our customers.

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation through to production, working closely with engineers, data scientists and product managers across the business to grow the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will bring deep technical expertise and sound judgement to some of our most complex problems, and will play a key role in shaping technical direction and influencing stakeholders across the business, while helping to raise the capability of those around you.

In this role as the Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will... 🚄 

- Work within cross-functional teams alongside data scientists, software engineers, data engineers and product managers

- Design and deliver machine learning models at scale that create measurable impact for the business

- Own the end-to-end machine learning delivery lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, evaluation, deployment and maintenance

- Shape technical direction for your area, making well-reasoned architectural and modelling decisions that stand up at scale

- Partner with and influence stakeholders across the business to propose innovative data products that make the most of Trainline's extensive datasets and the latest algorithms

- Build tools, frameworks and libraries that accelerate the delivery of ML products and improve team workflows

- Provide technical mentorship and support the development of less experienced engineers, without formal people management responsibility

- Take an active role in our AI and ML community, helping foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 

- An advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent experience

- Considerable experience productionising machine learning models, with strength in an area such as predictive modelling, classification, regression, optimisation or recommendation systems

- Strong proficiency in Python and open-source data libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn

- A solid grounding in statistical methodologies, along with data extraction, manipulation and feature engineering techniques

- Experience with Spark, agile delivery methods and CI/CD practices

- Familiarity with DevOps and MLOps tools and practices, such as Docker, Terraform and MLFlow

- Confidence influencing and communicating with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams

- Ideally, exposure to cloud infrastructure, NLP or large language models (such as fine-tuning, RAG or agents), graph technologies, or experience in the transport sector or with geographic information systems (GIS)

More information: 

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

- 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

- ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

- 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team 

- ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn , Instagram and Glassdoor !

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
AlphaPrompt ist ein Münchner B2B-Software-Startup für die institutionelle Immobilienwirtschaft. Wir bauen die Intelligente Immobilienakte: einen intelligenten Datenraum, der Dokumente automatisch klassifiziert, ausliest und mit nachvollziehbaren Quellen strukturiert, und einen Agentic Workspace, in dem KI-Agenten Prüfungen und Workflows übernehmen – von Mietverträgen über Nebenkostenabrechnungen bis zur Übergabe in Drittsysteme. Unsere Kunden sind Asset- und Property-Manager im DACH-Raum, die täglich damit arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Person, die unsere Kunden kennen. Du bringst neue Kunden und Objekte auf die Plattform, konfigurierst Datenräume und Agenten-Workflows für ihren Anwendungsfall, stimmst Ergebnisse mit ihnen ab und klärst Rückfragen – ohne Umweg über ein Support-Team. Wo die Plattform nicht reicht, baust du selbst: Anbindungen, Importe, Konfigurationen, kleinere Features und die Integration der KI-Funktionen unseres AI-Teams. Und weil du siehst, was Kunden immer wieder brauchen, machst du aus Einzellösungen Standard im Produkt. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und unserem Lead-Entwickler zusammen.

Was du bei uns machst

- Kunden-Onboarding verantworten: Datenräume aufsetzen, Dokumente einspielen, Metadaten und Workflows konfigurieren – und das Setup Schritt für Schritt automatisieren.

- In Terminen mit Asset- und Property-Managern Anforderungen aufnehmen, Ergebnisse zeigen und entscheiden, was konfiguriert, gebaut oder abgelehnt wird.

- Selbst über den ganzen Stack bauen – Backend in Python, Frontend in React: Importe, Exporte, Anbindungen an Drittsysteme wie SharePoint, kundenspezifische Erweiterungen.

- KI-Agenten unseres AI-Teams beim Kunden in Betrieb nehmen und ihre Ergebnisse an echten deutschen Dokumenten prüfen: Mietverträge, Nebenkostenabrechnungen, Wartungsprotokolle.

- Kundenfeedback ins Produkt zurückspielen: Muster erkennen, sauber beschreiben und Wiederkehrendes selbst zum Standard-Feature machen.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift – nicht verhandelbar. Dazu gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.

- Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Arbeitsplatz München im Office .

- Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung an einem Produkt, idealerweise SaaS/B2B.

- Full-Stack mit Schwerpunkt Backend (Python) – und du greifst auch ins Frontend (React/TypeScript), statt einen Bogen darum zu machen.

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kunden oder Fachbereichen – etwa als Solutions Engineer, Implementierungs- oder Technical Consultant oder Entwickler mit Kundenkontakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass ein Asset Manager sie versteht, und hältst einen Termin auch allein.

- Produktverständnis und Startup-Drive: Du willst wissen, wofür ein Feature da ist, nimmst dir Themen eigenständig und ziehst sie durch – schnell, pragmatisch, sauber.

- Grundverständnis für LLM-basierte Anwendungen – du musst keine Agenten bauen, aber nachvollziehen und integrieren können, was das AI-Team gebaut hat

Benefits

Was wir bieten

- Ein Produkt, das bei institutionellen Kunden im Einsatz ist – du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit beim Kunden bewirkt.

- Kurze Wege: direkt mit den Gründern und dem Lead-Entwickler; Entscheidungen fallen im Raum.

- KI als Kern des Produkts, nicht als Buzzword – und echten Einfluss auf die Roadmap, weil du am nächsten am Kunden bist.

- Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag, Büro in München.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior AI Engineer / Technical Consultant
description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Romandie office (Geneva/Lausanne) is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Technical Consultant / Senior AI Engineer , you will lead the design and delivery of impactful AI and data solutions. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with client advisory, guiding multi-disciplinary teams from opportunity framing to production deployment.

- 
Own solution architecture & delivery: Define end-to-end architectures (data, ML/LLM, APIs, security), make build/buy decisions, and drive projects from PoC to production with reliability, observability, and cost in mind.

- 
Lead complex PoCs & pilots: Scope, prototype, and validate AI/ML use cases (incl. LLMs/GenAI, RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation) and convert successful pilots into scalable products.

- 
Advanced programming & modeling: Build, adapt, and evaluate ML/DL/LLM models using Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain/LlamaIndex), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning/LoRA, vector search, and safety/guardrails.

- 
Cloud & MLOps/LLMOps: Design and operate solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS (CI/CD, containers, model serving, feature stores, vector DBs, monitoring, eval pipelines).

- 
Client advisory & stakeholder management: Translate business goals into technical roadmaps, present to senior stakeholders, manage risks and trade-offs, and ensure measurable business impact.

- 
Quality, security & governance: Enforce best practices on data privacy, model risk management, responsible AI, and documentation.

- 
Team leadership & mentoring: Coach engineers/consultants, perform code and design reviews, and help shape delivery standards and reusable accelerators.

- 
Pre-sales & thought leadership: Support proposals, estimates, and statements of work; contribute to assets, talks, and publications that advance Artefact’s AI offering.

Candidate Profile

Engineer first, consultant second — with a builder’s mindset and a track record of shipping.

- 
Experience: 5–8+ years in data/ML/AI engineering or adjacent roles, including end-to-end delivery of production AI systems (not just prototypes).

- 
Programming: Expert Python; solid software engineering (testing, packaging, CI/CD). SQL required; Java/Scala/TypeScript a plus.

- 
AI/ML: Hands-on with ML/DL and LLMs (prompting, fine-tuning/LoRA, embeddings/RAG, evaluation & observability, guardrails).

- 
Cloud: Deep experience on at least one major cloud (Azure, GCP, or AWS) deploying secure, scalable services.

- 
MLOps/LLMOps: Containers (Docker/Kubernetes), Git, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Cloud-native), model serving (FastAPI/TorchServe/Triton), experiment tracking, model registry, vector DBs (FAISS, Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch).

- 
Architecture & data: Designing data/ML platforms, APIs, microservices; familiarity with data pipelines and streaming is valued.

- 
Consulting skills: Requirements gathering, storytelling, senior stakeholder management, and clear documentation.

- 
Languages: Fluency in French and English (written & spoken) is mandatory.

- 
Work eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Nice to have 

- 
Experience with responsible AI/governance frameworks, security reviews, and cost optimization.

- 
Domain experience in one or more industries (e.g., retail, pharma, manufacturing, finance).

- 
Contributions to open-source, publications, or conference talks.

Why Join Us

- 
Strategy with a Data Edge: Operate at the intersection of boardroom strategy and cutting-edge AI engineering.

- 
Romandie Office Impact: High visibility from day one; help shape our Swiss footprint and work directly with senior leadership.

- 
Learning & Growth: Advanced training across strategy, AI/ML/LLM, and cloud; international missions and communities of practice.

- 
Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We move fast, deliver impact, and support each other’s growth.

Location: Lausanne / Geneva (Romandie)

If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Passion, curiosity, and impact orientation matter — tell us about yours.

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people .

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

💡 Your Mission: Build the layer every agent moves onto

As Senior Backend Engineer on the team behind our Agent SDK, you build and maintain the Kotlin foundation that our AI agents move onto. Agents have grown into a product surface across verticals and markets, and the layer underneath them needs a permanent owner. Your work makes the cost of the second and third agents visibly less than the first, so feature teams can ship at their own pace.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

- Build and maintain the SDK as an internal product. You shape the runtime and the client-facing contracts that consuming teams build on. The SDK has a roadmap of its own, and you help set it.

- You build the identity layer that agents run on , so customer-facing agents can write with a real user identity. Your responsibilities may include designing and shipping the auth plumbing, depending on what we have already built by your start date.

- Make every agent observable from the day it launches. You wire telemetry and error reporting into the SDK by default, and you integrate inference and anonymization so the SDK enforces them for every consumer.

- Build the test kit that the SDK still needs. You create it along with the architecture tests that protect the runtime internals, and you build the path that runs every SDK agent against our ML team's evaluation harness before a model change ships.

- Absorb ecosystem change on behalf of consuming teams. You own Koog version bumps and format compatibility, and you set the shared limits on tool output and token usage, so an upgrade lands once in the SDK and reaches everyone from there.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

- Several years of production backend experience on the JVM — Kotlin, Java, Scala or similar. Our stack is Kotlin, and you are ready to work in it.

- You have designed APIs that other engineers build against. An SDK or an internal platform where the contract is the product.

- You have built and maintained integrations , and kept them stable when the system on the other side changed.

- Testing and observability are part of how you build. 

- You are drawn to AI agent systems , and to the orchestration and evaluation work underneath them.

We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Backend Engineer - Acquisition Technology
description:
Backend Engineer - Acquisition Tech - DE

Hybrid in London or remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer 

You'll be the first engineer on the German side of Acquisition Tech, owning the customer acquisition systems that decide which small businesses iwoca reaches and how they convert.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

The Acquisition Tech team owns how iwoca reaches German small businesses – across paid advertising, SEO, social media, direct mail, and outbound sales – and how they become customers. The data and models behind every channel sit with the team.

You'll report to the engineering lead for iwoca's German market, based in London alongside the rest of the technical team. Day to day you'll work with a product manager and a data scientist in London, plus commercial strategy, marketing, and sales – some of whom sit in Germany.

You'll be the only engineer on the German side of acquisition, working in iwoca's UK Acquisition Tech team's codebase. You'll work with their engineers on code reviews and design decisions.

The role 

You'll build the backend behind iwoca's German acquisition technology – building on what already runs in the UK, and creating what Germany needs of its own.

- Ownership. You'll own the German side of the acquisition stack – from the lead-value signals iwoca sends to ad platforms, to the bidding and attribution built on them – and decide what to build from scratch.

- Technical strategy. You'll help shape the long-term roadmap. The team sets commercial objectives; you’ll shape the architecture, scaling, and technical direction.

- Funnel optimisation. You'll work with marketing and data science to target relevant businesses across paid search, direct mail, and outbound sales, and to convert more of them once they arrive. You'll integrate third-party APIs to minimise friction in sign-up and improve the lead data behind every channel.

- Data engineering. You'll build the pipelines, databases, and REST APIs behind the acquisition stack, plus the HubSpot tooling the sales team use.

- Models in production. You'll engineer the features that data scientists need, put their models into production, and set up the versioning and monitoring that keep them running.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Backend engineering. You have hands-on experience designing and building backend systems in Python, in production.

- SQL. You are comfortable in SQL beyond CRUD. You shape schemas, tune queries, and reason about how data flows through relational systems.

- End-to-end. You take work from an initial problem through to delivery, shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

- Commercial or product thinking. You're comfortable working directly with marketing and sales. You take a business goal, dig into the root of what they need and why, then shape what gets built – as well as owning how.

- AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

- Full-stack. You’re open to coding frontend elements, particularly in React or TypeScript.

- Python stack. You have worked with SQLAlchemy, scikit-learn, pandas, and PostgreSQL.

- Database design. You have designed, built, and managed relational databases.

- Analytics tooling. You have used Snowflake, Looker, or the equivalent.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Engineering the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

The Demand Core team builds the infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open our ad unit Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure, downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. You will build and operate the services that power these decisions 200 million times every day .

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals , geo, fraud status, budget caps to rank potential user performance in milliseconds . Beyond campaign distribution, the team owns the entire ad interaction chain: processing clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer , and in-app events that trigger rewards. These events are broadcasted through a hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka , directly powering our advertiser dashboards, publisher reward payouts, and ad campaign scoring pipelines, all backed by DynamoDB .

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: 

Production Golang Systems Expertise: You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

High-Scale Data & API Optimization: You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.

Data Science & Algorithmic Integration: You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.

Collaborative Technical Communication: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.

Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling: Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 

What’s in It for You? 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

- Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

- Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

- Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

- Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

- Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

- Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

- Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

- The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

Nice-to-haves:

title: Senior Reviewer - Code & Web Templates
description:
About Us 

At Envato , we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

About the role 

The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets.

As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations.

This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories.

What you'll be doing

Scope of Review Coverage 

- This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups:
- Web Themes & UI Templates.
- Site Templates.
- UI Templates.
- Template Kits.
- ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable.
- WordPress themes.
- WordPress plugins.
- Scripts.
- Plugins.
- Code assets.
- Front-end templates and components.
- Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products.
- PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets.

- Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard.

Content Review & Quality Assessment 

- Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards.

- Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category.

- Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value.

- Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines.

Risk Management & Escalation 

- Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review.

- Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust.

Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement 

- Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team.

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials.

- Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency.

- Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends.

Team Collaboration & Operational Support 

- Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team.

- Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised.

- Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

About you

Key Capabilities 

- Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics.

- Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues.

- Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience.

- Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability.

- Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance.

- Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies.

- Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories.

- Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally.

- High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly.

- Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations.

- Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment.

- Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English.

Required Technical Coverage

This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time.

- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development

- PHP and WordPress development.

- WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems.

- Site Templates and UI Templates.

- Template Kits and page-builder-based assets.

- Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products.

- Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review.

- Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.

- Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations.

Additional Experience 

- Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace.

- Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon.

- Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage.

- Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations.

- Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions.

- Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards.

Compensation

Additional Information

Life at Envato 

• Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need. 

• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.

• Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico.

• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.

• Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.

• Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.

• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.

• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.

• Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave. 

• Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus.

• Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more.

• 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro).

• Private Health Insurance (SGMM).

• Unlimited Ebooks.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Remote UK
description:
Who We Are 

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us 

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

- Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.

- Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.

- Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

- Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.

- Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.

- Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.

- Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.

- Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.

- Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills : we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability

- Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible : roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot

- Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments

- Understanding of networking fundamentals

- Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python

- Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux

- Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)

- Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state

- A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

- Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)

- Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)

- Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

The Kind of Person We're After

- You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't

- You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership even if they all want different things

- You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought

- You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool

- Autonomously drive outcomes : we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

What We Offer

- True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.

- A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.

- A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks 

- 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 

- Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment

- 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year

- Private Medical and Dental Insurance 

- Enhanced pension contributions

- Cycle to Work scheme 

- Eye Care Vouchers 

- Life Assurance

- Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs

- Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion 

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.
